answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent to a Merkle-rooted ledger while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces any Sybil clone to perform sequential work proportional to stake-weighted difficulty. In the game the falcon, basalt, and marble primitives guarantee a robust Nash equilibrium because no rational adversary can improve payoff by deviating.
